issues.title: Bot check returns 200 with body
issues.detail: When a bot is detected, the endpoint returns `json({ beep: 'boop' })` with a 200 status. Bots silently receive success responses that look like real sessions, and monitoring cannot distinguish bot requests from legitimate ones by status code.

issues.title: Session drift is not atomic
issues.detail: When an identify call changes the distinct ID, the session ID changes. If a concurrent request arrives with the old cache token before the new one is received, it continues on the old session, potentially splitting events across two sessions.

AUTHORED.title: AI Agent Access
AUTHORED.sub: Model Context Protocol server exposing analytics tools to AI agents, plus the typed API client it uses.
AUTHORED.detail: An MCP server registers 23 read-only tools that wrap the Umami API. Two transports serve it: an HTTP endpoint and a stdio CLI, both using the API client to call route handlers rather than touching storage.

group.note: Four orthogonal layers: how requests arrive, how they authenticate, the tool catalogue, and the typed HTTP client underneath.

issues.title: Dispatch only allows GET and POST methods
issues.detail: The `DispatchRoute` type restricts methods to `'GET' | 'POST'`, and all current routes use GET. If a tool ever needed PUT or DELETE, the type would have to change. Safe now since all tools are read-only, but narrower than route handlers support.
